text: Your agents can all be right, and the system can still fail. Permissions, human gates, budgets, and stop rules can disagree between agents. One agent may only propose while another can execute. The models are not necessarily the failure. The operating layer is. Cross-Agent Operating Kit aligns a multi-agent stack with one master policy, agent adapters, conflict checks, human gates, and budget guards. Personal is sixty-nine dollars. One operating layer before another agent.
